The checks test the job itself, not only files: the composed script's content/owner/mode; a real Plasma session (who lists p8testuser on tty2) with agent runs whose runner line, the header's logged-in line and a policy line reporting id -un = p8testuser all come from t1 onward; the autostart run at login bounded to before the first agent run; and no policy line before the session.
